caption: A sharply focused silver metal wire grid, topped by a bent rail, fills the foreground while an out-of-focus orange container sits behind it. Initially the orange object stands roughly upright and toward the center-left, its elongated body visible through the mesh. The blurred backdrop shows a dark blue-black area beside a tan region on the right, with a small green shape resting at the lower-left. Over time the orange object slowly drifts toward the upper-right. During this movement it tilts and rotates so that its rounded base turns to face the camera, becoming the dominant visible part. Toward the end it holds a near-fixed position in the upper-right, showing only slight jitter. Throughout, the foreground grid stays stationary and in focus, with the camera fixed while the object moves behind it.
